diagnosis.narrative: The series shows no clear long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.146), which favours a robust combination.
